Our Services

Whether you're expanding into the UK market or need hands-on business facilitation, we provide local expertise, logistics, and support—without the need to travel.

Investment Facilitation

Our investment facilitation service is tailored to help foreign businesses establish a solid foundation in the UK. We guide you through every step—helping you choose the right business structure, connecting you with local partners, identifying the best locations, and ensuring compliance with local regulations. Our goal is to remove the friction from market entry so that you can focus on scaling your business.

Operations & Logistics

WeRep becomes your UK-based operations team. From sourcing and managing vendors to overseeing warehousing and deliveries, we handle the day-to-day logistics of your business. Our detailed reports keep you informed while saving you the cost and effort of maintaining an in-country presence.

Training & Development

Whether you’re sending staff to the UK for specialized training or hosting courses locally, we manage the logistics. From airport pickup to accommodation and course facilitation, we ensure a seamless experience that maximizes learning outcomes and minimizes travel stress.

Event Representation

Can’t attend a crucial seminar or trade fair? WeRep attends on your behalf, ensuring your business remains visible and engaged. We collect marketing materials, engage in conversations, and report back with photos, contacts, and insights that matter.

Meetings & Conferences

We don’t just attend; we represent. From business negotiations to networking events, we act as your voice and presence. With detailed minutes, key takeaways, and recordings where permitted, your business won’t miss a beat.

Product Inspection

Our team performs on-site product checks—including live video inspections or detailed photo documentation—to ensure that what you ordered meets your quality standards before any shipment or sign-off.

Warehousing & Storage

We provide access to trusted, secure warehousing facilities across the UK—whether short-term or long-term. Perfect for businesses needing local fulfilment centers or scalable inventory solutions.

Cargo Clearance & Delivery

From port to final destination, we manage the full spectrum of customs clearance and delivery. Our familiarity with UK regulatory processes ensures your cargo clears smoothly and gets where it needs to go—on time.

Personal Shopper

Need to source items from the UK? Whether designer brands or everyday goods, we make discreet purchases on your behalf and handle secure international shipping.

Airport Meet & Greet and Accommodation Facilitation

First impressions matter. We coordinate warm airport welcomes and book quality accommodation so your arrival or that of your staff feels effortless and professional.

Let Us Help You Succeed In The UK

Partner with WeRep and experience seamless business expansion, expert logistics, and personalized support. Let's get started on your UK journey!
